name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell 72 GB (reference specifications)
description: Documented hardware identity, not a currently purchasable offering or measured runtime tuple. Research snapshot; no serving or training-fit claim. precisions list the v1 enum values supported on Blackwell; int4 is omitted (CUDA Table 33 INT4 cell blank for compute capability 12.x); FP4/FP6 are native Blackwell formats with no v1 enum value, so their absence is not a claim they are unsupported.

Memory Configuration "48 GB GDDR7 with ECC | 72 GB GDDR7 with ECC": two SKUs; this item is the 72 GB SKU (the 48 GB SKU is a separate item). Page: "Max Power Consumption 300 W".
